statusModel.rule: Academic/content status and delivery-page status are independent. An academic status of active does not imply that a dedicated course delivery page exists.

deliveryStates.planned: No dedicated course delivery page is asserted.
deliveryStates.production_ready: Reserved for a future explicit release decision; not inferred from page existence.

notes: Phase 7F-I adds catalog-aligned graduate instructional course pages for AUT-520, AUT-530, and AUT-550.
AUT-530 page availability does not establish undergraduate EV coursework equivalency; that condition requires human or institutional verification.
Graduate page availability does not establish admissions eligibility, degree equivalency, mathematics preparation, graduate standing, or prerequisite satisfaction.
AUT-420 remains deferred pending human/institutional verification of industry employment or approved internship placement.
AUT-120 and AUT-150 remain intentionally blocked from canonical delivery until dedicated canonical curriculum content is approved.
The existing /courses/aut-250/ page remains the HEV formative-training package crosswalked from catalog AUT-330; it is not the delivery page for catalog AUT-250 Automotive Diagnostics I.
Academic/content status remains independent from delivery-page status; building a page does not authorize assessment.
The filesystem contains eighteen dedicated course/training page directories in total, of which seventeen are catalog-aligned course pages.
